extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record; automated scaffold claims were replaced with bounded source-located mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both DMS-DA6 terminal forms disrupt/permeabilize Gram-positive bacterial membranes, with the amidated form showing stronger S. aureus membrane permeabilization under the ONPG assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DMS-DA6-OH and DMS-DA6-NH2; DMS-DA6-NH2 stronger in the reported assay

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=1:Fig 1; xml:sec=20:DMS-DA6-NH2 has a greater capacity than DMS-DA6-OH to permeabilize the S. aureus membrane

mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure curves were not digitized; final claim is qualitative and assay-bounded.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DMS-DA6 peptides interact with bacterial/membrane lipid systems; fluorescence, leakage, CD/NMR, and DSC evidence supports membrane perturbation rather than a non-membrane intracellular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biophysical mechanism evidence is model-membrane and membrane-mimetic context, not a live-cell molecular target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptidoglycan potentiates DMS-DA6 membrane perturbation/permeabilization and is a plausible contributor to Gram-positive selectivity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DMS-DA6 peptides with DMPG/PGN model systems and S. aureus/S. epidermidis Gram-positive context

source_locator.locator: xml:table=5; xml:fig=8:Fig 8; xml:sec=23:DMS-DA6-NH2 interacts with peptidoglycan

mechanism_claims.limitations: PGN interaction is supported as potentiating membrane disruption; exact binding stoichiometry is not normalized into the final record.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: C-terminal amidation improves antibacterial potency, but the paper does not attribute the effect to a major charge, stability, or global structure difference alone.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a bounded comparative interpretation, not an independent direct mechanism class.

mechanism_quality_control.overclaim_prevention: No nucleic-acid or unsupported intracellular mechanism was retained from reference-section keyword hits.
